purpose: Grouped reference for cfd2d_mesh_config.json. The editable file is intentionally compact; ramair_2d_mesh_builder.py maps these keys to older internal names for backward compatibility.

gmsh_and_global.domain_type: Single authoritative outer-domain selector. Supported values are circular_50c, ross_cgrid_like, rectangular_balaji and debug_20c; only the dimensions belonging to the selected type are used.
gmsh_and_global.domain_circular_radius_chord: Radius of the circular validation domain divided by chord. The standard value is 50c.
gmsh_and_global.domain_cgrid_upstream_chord: C-grid-like upstream rounded-boundary distance from the leading edge, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_cgrid_downstream_chord: C-grid-like downstream boundary position from the leading edge, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_cgrid_top_chord: C-grid-like upper boundary distance from the chord axis, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_cgrid_bottom_chord: C-grid-like lower boundary distance from the chord axis, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_rectangular_upstream_chord: Rectangular-domain upstream boundary distance from the leading edge, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_rectangular_downstream_chord: Rectangular-domain downstream boundary position from the leading edge, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_rectangular_top_chord: Rectangular-domain upper boundary distance from the chord axis, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_rectangular_bottom_chord: Rectangular-domain lower boundary distance from the chord axis, divided by chord.
gmsh_and_global.domain_debug_radius_chord: Radius of the small circular software-debug domain divided by chord; it is not suitable for aerodynamic validation.
gmsh_and_global.mesh_level_origin: Records which coarse, medium or fine starting set seeded the editable configuration. It is provenance, not a second active override.
gmsh_and_global.mesh_configuration_mode: level_base means the current values still match a starting set; custom means a loaded or manually edited configuration has priority over every mesh-level preset.
gmsh_and_global.gmsh_backend: auto prefers the Gmsh Python API installed in the application environment; cli preserves the validated command-line path. An explicit backend failure is reported and is never hidden by silently reusing an old mesh.
gmsh_and_global.geometry_mode: Current OpenFOAM-ready open profile representation. thin_solid_fabric gives the fabric a small finite thickness so exterior and cavity are one connected fluid region through the LE opening.
gmsh_and_global.gmsh_threads: Threads passed to gmsh with -nt. The project default is 12 on the Ryzen 7 4800H when running from the native Linux filesystem, never /mnt/c/OneDrive.
gmsh_and_global.gmsh_mesh_algorithm_2d: Gmsh 2D algorithm. 5 is Delaunay; 6 is Frontal-Delaunay. The validated zero-thickness open-airfoil preset uses 6 because it removed the remaining low-interpolation-weight inlet faces.
gmsh_and_global.gmsh_random_factor: Small perturbation used by Gmsh during meshing. Keep small; do not use it to hide bad geometry.
gmsh_and_global.gmsh_random_seed: Fixed pseudo-random seed used by Gmsh. Keeping it constant makes repeated quality comparisons reproducible.
gmsh_and_global.run_boundary_layer: Global on/off for Gmsh BoundaryLayer field.
gmsh_and_global.target_y_plus: Used only when *_use_yplus_first_cell_height=true. y1 is estimated with a flat-plate turbulent skin-friction approximation.
gmsh_and_global.spanwise_thickness_chord: One-cell extrusion thickness divided by chord for OpenFOAM 2D meshes.
gmsh_and_global.spanwise_layers: Must stay 1 for frontAndBack empty OpenFOAM 2D cases.
gmsh_and_global.max_internal_parse_mesh_size_mb: Skip the optional pure-Python MSH statistics parser above this file size. Gmsh, gmshToFoam and checkMesh still run normally.
gmsh_and_global.max_internal_parse_elements: Skip the optional pure-Python MSH statistics parser above this Gmsh element count. The debug default is 75000 to avoid spending more time parsing than meshing.
gmsh_and_global.max_cells: Hard upper limit used by quality control after a real cell count can be obtained.
gmsh_and_global.min_cells_warning: Warn when a real mesh contains fewer cells than this value; it does not fabricate a PASS.
gmsh_and_global.stop_if_negative_cells: Retained safety switch for downstream OpenFOAM quality decisions.
gmsh_and_global.stop_if_geometry_invalid: Stop before meshing when the connectivity and geometry audits find an invalid profile.

wall_curve.closed_wall_curve_method: standard: two_spline_te_cap. Writes one non-periodic main profile spline and one tangent-continuous TE cap spline.
wall_curve.closed_wall_target_nodes: Total node target distributed between the main wall and TE cap with Transfinite Curve. This controls tangential BL columns.
wall_curve.closed_te_bump_strength: Gmsh Bump coefficient on the main profile spline. 1 is uniform; values below 1 cluster nodes at both TE-cap junctions. The bounded Courant study keeps 0.50 with 2000 total wall nodes and 18 target nodes on the cap; closed_te_refinement_width_chord remains 0 so no second geometric weighting refines the straight TE neighbors.
wall_curve.closed_te_target_nodes: Node target reserved for the actual rounded TE cap. Increase this to refine the curved closure without forcing extra nodes along the straight upper/lower wall.
wall_curve.closed_te_transition_min_nodes: Minimum node count on each non-TE wall curve before the Bump distribution is applied.
wall_curve.closed_profile_target_points: Number of preprocessed points written before Gmsh. This controls geometry fidelity; Transfinite controls mesh nodes on the curve.
wall_curve.closed_profile_min_spacing_chord: Minimum accepted spacing during duplicate cleanup, divided by chord.
wall_curve.closed_te_rounding_*: Tangent-continuous Bezier TE closure controls. Points/window/min_gap define where the consecutive TE closing segment is replaced.
wall_curve.closed_te_refinement_*: Optional preprocessor weighting near the TE before Gmsh. The validated default width is 0: the rounded cap geometry and closed_te_target_nodes carry the local refinement without shrinking points on straight upper/lower sections. This is separate from the Bump transition.

boundary_layer.closed_use_yplus_first_cell_height: true: compute first cell height from target_y_plus and case physics. false: use closed_first_cell_height_m exactly.
boundary_layer.closed_first_cell_height_m: Manual first BL cell height in metres, active when closed_use_yplus_first_cell_height=false. The application displays its equivalent y1/chord alongside it.
boundary_layer.closed_boundary_layer_growth: Normal growth ratio. Around 1.08-1.12 is smoother than aggressive growth.
boundary_layer.closed_boundary_layer_total_thickness_ch: Optional total BL thickness cap divided by chord. Null means derive total thickness from y1, layers and growth.
boundary_layer.closed_boundary_layer_aniso_max_deg: BoundaryLayer AnisoMax. Allows anisotropic metric across high-curvature turns; lower values are stricter.
boundary_layer.closed_boundary_layer_intersect_metrics: Writes Field[1].IntersectMetrics=1 to help Gmsh intersect BL metrics near tight geometry.

cell_sizes.closed_near_wall_size_from_bl: If true, derives the triangle target automatically from both the last normal BL scale and mean tangential wall spacing. The shared BL-front edge is tangential, so the rule uses max(last layer scale, 0.85*tangential spacing).
cell_sizes.closed_near_wall_size_chord: Manual near-wall triangular size divided by chord when closed_near_wall_size_from_bl=false.
cell_sizes.closed_nearfield_*: Three consecutive Distance/Threshold fields: fine BL-compatible cells, a moderate aerodynamic nearfield, then a slow outer transition. DistMax is the end of the moderate region, not the farfield boundary.
cell_sizes.closed_nearfield_outer_size_chord: Moderate outer-nearfield target reached around closed_nearfield_dist_max_chord.
cell_sizes.closed_farfield_transition_dist_chord: Distance where the slow outer transition finally reaches closed_farfield_size_chord. For the 50c validation domain this is 45c.
cell_sizes.closed_farfield_size_chord: Farfield boundary cell size divided by chord.
cell_sizes.domain_radius_chord: Circular debug domain radius divided by chord.

wall_curve.open_geometry_representation: Select the open-profile topology. zero_thickness_base_profile is the verified default: no artificial fabric thickness, exterior BL around the base-profile contour and a selectively stitched fluid inlet. finite_thickness_fabric retains the previous thin-solid comparison topology.
wall_curve.open_base_profile_variant: Closed, uncut case-package variant used only to reconstruct the curved base-profile segment across the open inlet. Its chord-normalized LE path is scaled and joined exactly to the cut-profile lips.
wall_curve.open_base_inlet_alignment_mode: similarity is the production mode: one translation, rotation and uniform scale maps the uncut-base arc endpoints to the cut lips while preserving the complete curve shape. endpoint_blend retains the former local smoothstep deformation only for comparison.
wall_curve.open_base_inlet_blend_fraction: Legacy endpoint_blend-only parameter. It is ignored by similarity alignment.
wall_curve.open_zero_thickness_contour_target_nodes: Total tangential node target distributed by arc length over the complete lower-wall, rounded-TE, upper-wall and nonphysical inlet contour. One shared spacing removes discretization jumps where the physical wall role changes at the inlet lips.
wall_curve.open_zero_thickness_inlet_normal_y1_fact: In hybrid_boundary_extension this multiplies y1 only for the initial normal compatibility strip. It never defines the inlet tangential width or the remaining cavity size. The measured default is 8: on the 1 m open validation mesh with manual y1=25 um it raised the minimum interpolation weight from 0.05857 to 0.09152 and the minimum neighbour-volume ratio from 0.08297 to 0.13434 with 1.27% more cells.
wall_curve.open_wall_curve_method: standard: segmented_outer_splines. Upper, rounded-TE and lower exterior splines form a closed one-sided BL loop with a nonphysical inlet interface. Exterior, inlet transition and cavity are conformal fluid surfaces.
wall_curve.open_single_connected_surface_2d: Advanced topology switch. False uses three conformal external/inlet/cavity surfaces and is the robust default for a one-sided Gmsh BoundaryLayer. They become one connected OpenFOAM fluid region after coincident interface nodes are merged. True embeds the inlet line in one Plane Surface and remains experimental with a BL on that line.
wall_curve.open_inlet_boundary_layer_mode: Primary inlet strategy. full_prismatic_bridge_without_fans keeps the complete exterior prism bridge over the nonphysical inlet interface while avoiding radial fan sectors. With the selected exterior-Bezier/interior-line connector, all checkMesh categories except one upper-lip high-skew face pass. Diagnostic fan and triangular modes remain selectable but are not approved defaults. No mode creates an inlet wall or physical patch.
wall_curve.open_inlet_bridge_smoothing_enabled: Use a cubic Bezier for the nonphysical exterior inlet interface, with endpoint tangents inherited from the neighboring walls. It preserves a connected fluid opening and creates no wall patch; the cavity-side interface remains straight.
wall_curve.open_inlet_bridge_smoothing_handle_fract: Bezier tangent-handle length divided by inlet opening. The bounded sensitivity selected 0.08 together with transition growth 1.22; this pair passed real OpenFOAM 13 checkMesh on the 20c debug case. This is geometric smoothing, not a mesh-size control.
wall_curve.open_inlet_transition_elements: Elements in the narrow conformal fluid connector between exterior and cavity. graded_quads is recommended: a short orthogonal block starts at the exterior y1 scale and grows normally with a bounded progression before meeting the triangular cavity mesh. graded_triangles is retained as a diagnostic comparison because alternating diagonals can create severe non-orthogonality. triangles, transfinite_triangles and recombined_quads preserve legacy comparisons. None creates a physical inlet wall.
wall_curve.open_inlet_transition_growth: Maximum normal growth used by the automatic graded inlet throat. The measured debug default is 1.22; the actual progression is solved below this bound so the rows exactly span the finite fabric thickness. Constant spacing and semicircular lip caps produced worse checkMesh metrics in controlled comparisons.
wall_curve.open_inlet_connector_normal_nodes: Normal nodes through the inlet throat. Zero selects the recommended automatic count from y1, fabric thickness and open_inlet_transition_growth. A value of two or greater explicitly overrides that count for a controlled sensitivity study.
wall_curve.open_lip_cap_rounding_enabled: Optional numerical geometry: replace each straight finite-thickness lip cap with one ordered upstream semicircular BSpline. It targets the connector-corner cells and does not turn the fluid inlet into a wall.
wall_curve.open_lip_cap_rounding_points: Odd geometric sample count for each lip-cap BSpline. Seven resolves this very small radius; tangential mesh nodes remain controlled independently.
wall_curve.open_surface_target_nodes: Base tangential target for the complete exterior fabric contour. The default is 1600, distributed between upper, rounded-TE and lower splines; it is not 1600 nodes on every segment.
wall_curve.open_surface_transfinite_multiplier: Multiplier applied to open_surface_target_nodes before distributing nodes. Keep 1.0 unless performing a deliberate tangential-resolution study.
wall_curve.open_wall_end_bump_enabled / open_wall_e: Apply Gmsh Using Bump independently to the outer upper and lower splines. It refines both ends of each branch: inlet lip and TE junction. The TE cap remains separately and uniformly controlled.
wall_curve.open_zero_thickness_te_transfinite_min_n: Minimum node target reserved for the curved exterior TE spline in zero_thickness_base_profile. The validated default is 32; those nodes are reallocated from the straight upper/lower branches so the global contour target is conserved.
wall_curve.open_te_transfinite_min_nodes: Minimum exterior TE node target for the retained finite_thickness_fabric topology. Its default remains 40.
wall_curve.open_te_refinement_width_chord / open_te: Limit TE geometric weighting and the local TE-to-triangle transition. Defaults 0.012 and 0.010 chord keep the fine zone close to the rounded closure.
wall_curve.open_lip_transfinite_min_nodes: Minimum tangential count on each exterior upper/lower branch before the end Bump distribution is applied. The measured open-airfoil default is 160.
wall_curve.open_inlet_marker_transfinite_nodes: Nodes on each nonphysical inlet connector. This is the principal inlet-line discretization control; the measured default is 176. It never creates a wall or OpenFOAM patch.
wall_curve.open_inlet_marker_bump_strength: Gmsh Bump coefficient shared by the exterior, transition and cavity inlet lines. It clusters their fixed node count towards both lips so the graded throat resolves the acute corners without refining the complete opening uniformly.
wall_curve.open_inner_wall_node_factor: Fraction of the corresponding exterior count used on the long inner walls. The zero-thickness default 0.42 reduces unnecessary cavity cells while retaining concentrated nodes at inlet and TE.
wall_curve.open_inner_te_node_factor: Fraction of exterior TE nodes retained on the curved inner TE. The default 0.28 is combined with an 18-node minimum so the narrow closure remains resolved without copying the exterior cap count.
wall_curve.open_inner_wall_end_bump_*: Gmsh Bump on long inner upper/lower splines refines both inlet and TE ends while keeping the middle of the cavity wall cheaper. At equal node count, smaller positive coefficients concentrate more nodes at both ends; the verified default is 0.35.
wall_curve.open_inner_wall_min_nodes: Lower node limit on each long inner upper/lower spline.
wall_curve.open_inner_te_min_nodes: Lower node limit on the curved inner TE spline.

boundary_layer.open_use_yplus_first_cell_height: true: compute open y1 from target_y_plus. false: use open_first_cell_height_m.
boundary_layer.open_first_cell_height_m: Manual first BL cell height in metres. The application displays the corresponding fraction of the active profile chord.
boundary_layer.open_boundary_layer_layers: Requested BL layers on the exterior fabric wall only.
boundary_layer.open_boundary_layer_trim_end_segments: Experimental. Stops the exterior BL several profile points before each inlet lip so that the final lip neighborhood is triangular. Disabled by default because the Gmsh BoundaryLayer field cannot always terminate on a smooth degree-two point of the fabric loop.
boundary_layer.open_boundary_layer_trim_end_points: Number of exterior profile point intervals omitted from the BL at each lip when experimental trimming is enabled.
boundary_layer.open_boundary_layer_lip_fan_points: Angular subdivisions requested by Gmsh FanPointsSizesList only when full_prismatic_bridge_with_fans is selected. Five matches Gmsh's documented BoundaryLayerFanElements default. Controlled tests showed that fans caused the worst inlet cells, so the parameter is ignored by the recommended no-fan mode and by triangular_inlet_no_bl.
boundary_layer.open_minimum_fabric_thickness_chord: Minimum numerical fabric thickness divided by chord for open profiles. The application edits it in metres and stores x/c for the mesher. The selected debug default is 4e-4, approximately 1.206 mm at c=3.016 m. This is a meshing thickness, not a claim about physical fabric thickness.

cell_sizes.open_near_wall_size_from_bl: If true, derives local exterior, TE, inlet and lip-cap triangle targets from the last normal BL layer and local tangential spacing. It does not prescribe the first-cell height twice: it controls the triangle edge leaving the BL front so the Delaunay mesh cannot jump directly to farfield size.
cell_sizes.open_near_wall_size_chord: Manual exterior near-wall triangular size divided by chord, used only when open_near_wall_size_from_bl=false.
cell_sizes.open_cavity_wall_size_chord: Inner-wall cavity size, without prism BL.
cell_sizes.open_cavity_inlet_size_strategy: hybrid_boundary_extension is the production strategy. A very short y1-compatible normal strip avoids a cell-centre jump, then Gmsh Extend obtains SizeBnd from the local average length of the already meshed inlet edges and grows it to the cavity-core size. boundary_extension omits the strip; boundary_uniform is a diagnostic constant-size cavity; staged_explicit preserves the former y1-capped fields.
cell_sizes.open_cavity_inlet_extension_power: Exponent in Gmsh Extend: f=((DistMax-d)/DistMax)^Power. Values below 1 retain the inherited boundary size farther into the cavity and create a slower, smoother growth; the default is 0.75.
cell_sizes.open_internal_inlet_*: With hybrid_boundary_extension, matching_transition is only the short normal compatibility strip and dist_max is the distance over which Gmsh grows from the actual inlet edge length to the cavity-core size. Legacy intermediate controls are used only by staged_explicit.
cell_sizes.open_internal_te_*: Cavity-only TE refinement. Its minimum size is derived from the independent inner-TE tangential spacing, then grows locally to the cavity-core size over the selected distance.
cell_sizes.open_nearfield_*: Three-stage exterior Distance/Threshold transition: BL-compatible near wall, moderate aerodynamic nearfield, and growth to the distant boundary. The final field keeps SizeMax active outside its DistMax so Gmsh cannot jump to an unconstrained size.
cell_sizes.open_transition_sigmoid_enabled: Use Gmsh Threshold.Sigmoid for smooth size interpolation in the staged exterior and cavity transitions. Linear interpolation remains available for comparison, but the real study produced poorer local skewness and volume-ratio margins.
cell_sizes.open_nearfield_outer_size_chord: Moderate exterior size reached before the slow farfield transition.
cell_sizes.open_farfield_transition_dist_chord: Distance where the open-profile mesh reaches open_farfield_size_chord.
cell_sizes.open_farfield_size_chord: Coarse farfield target. The selected circular-50c candidate uses 3.5 chord after a sigmoid transition ending at 10 chord; local quality is controlled by the preceding stages, not by extending a fine plateau to the boundary.

editable_key_help.config_schema_version: Internal compatibility version for the compact mesh configuration. Change only when migrating the builder schema.
editable_key_help.fabric_thickness_chord: Finite numerical fabric thickness divided by chord for open profiles. The application presents and edits the physical value in metres, then stores x/c for portable scaling. It separates exterior and interior wall faces while leaving the inlet fluid opening connected.
editable_key_help.extrude_to_3d_for_openfoam: Extrudes the 2D mesh to one 3D cell layer so frontAndBack can be declared empty in OpenFOAM.
editable_key_help.closed_recombine_boundary_layer: Recombine closed-profile BoundaryLayer triangles into quadrilateral layers before the one-cell extrusion.
editable_key_help.closed_profile_preprocess_enabled: Enable duplicate filtering, tangent TE closure and curvature-aware profile resampling before Gmsh geometry generation.
editable_key_help.closed_te_rounding_enabled: Replace the consecutive straight TE closing segment with the tangent-continuous rounded cap.
editable_key_help.closed_te_rounding_points: Geometric samples used to represent the rounded TE cap before Gmsh; this is separate from mesh-node count.
editable_key_help.closed_te_rounding_window_chord: Maximum chordwise window used to identify the TE closure endpoints for geometric rounding.
editable_key_help.closed_te_rounding_min_gap_chord: Minimum TE gap required before inserting the rounded geometric cap.
editable_key_help.closed_te_refinement_width_chord: Chordwise reach of curvature-aware geometric resampling near the TE.
editable_key_help.closed_te_refinement_strength: Relative geometric resampling weight near the TE; higher values allocate more profile points there.
editable_key_help.closed_te_refinement_max_weight: Upper bound on TE geometric weighting to prevent collapsed consecutive segments.
editable_key_help.closed_near_wall_size_bl_factor: Multiplier applied to the BL-derived last-layer/tangential scale when setting adjacent triangle size.
editable_key_help.closed_nearfield_enabled: Enable the gradual Distance/Threshold transition between the closed-profile BL front and farfield.
editable_key_help.closed_nearfield_dist_min_chord: Distance from the wall where the finest BL-front-compatible triangle size is retained.
editable_key_help.closed_nearfield_intermediate_dist_chord: Distance where the closed nearfield reaches its intermediate size.
editable_key_help.closed_nearfield_dist_max_chord: Distance where growth reaches the moderate outer-nearfield target.
editable_key_help.closed_nearfield_intermediate_size_chord: Intermediate triangle size used to avoid a direct BL-to-farfield jump.
editable_key_help.closed_nearfield_outer_size_chord: Moderate size at the outer edge of the aerodynamic nearfield.
editable_key_help.closed_farfield_transition_dist_chord: Distance where the final slow transition reaches the farfield target.
editable_key_help.open_boundary_layer_total_thickness_chor: Optional total open-profile BL thickness divided by chord. Null derives it from y1, layer count and growth.
editable_key_help.open_recombine_boundary_layer: Recombine open exterior BoundaryLayer elements into quadrilateral layers; the inlet and cavity remain triangular.
editable_key_help.open_boundary_layer_aniso_max_deg: Gmsh BoundaryLayer AnisoMax used at high-curvature exterior turns and lip fans.
editable_key_help.open_boundary_layer_trim_end_segments: Experimental triangular lip transition. Leave false for the currently validated mesh path.
editable_key_help.open_boundary_layer_trim_end_points: Number of point intervals removed from each BL endpoint when experimental lip trimming is enabled.
editable_key_help.open_near_wall_size_bl_factor: Multiplier used when deriving the first exterior triangle size from the final BL layer and tangential spacing.
editable_key_help.open_surface_transfinite_progression: Tangential progression on curves not using Bump. One gives uniform spacing along that curve.
editable_key_help.open_wall_end_bump_enabled: Enable symmetric end clustering on exterior upper/lower wall splines near inlet lips and TE junctions.
editable_key_help.open_wall_end_bump_strength: Gmsh Bump intensity on exterior wall splines. Values farther from one increase end clustering; validate visually because convention sensitivity depends on curve orientation.
editable_key_help.open_te_refinement_width_chord: Chordwise geometric/sizing reach of the exterior TE refinement.
editable_key_help.open_te_transition_distance_chord: Distance over which cells leave the fine exterior TE interface size.
editable_key_help.open_inner_wall_end_bump_enabled: Enable a cheaper symmetric end refinement on cavity upper/lower wall splines.
editable_key_help.open_inner_wall_end_bump_strength: Bump intensity on inner cavity walls; normally weaker than the exterior distribution.
editable_key_help.open_surface_size_le_chord: Local triangle target in the exterior LE neighborhood outside the more focused lip zone.
editable_key_help.open_cavity_wall_transition_chord: Distance over which cavity cells grow from inner-wall size to cavity-core size.
editable_key_help.open_internal_te_refinement_enabled: Enable a cavity-only refinement around the narrow internal TE.
editable_key_help.open_internal_te_dist_max_chord: Extent of the internal TE refinement before reaching cavity-core size.
editable_key_help.open_internal_te_size_factor: Factor applied to the inner-TE interface scale for its local triangle target.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_refinement_enabled: Enable fine triangular cells immediately inside the inlet and gradual growth toward the cavity core.
editable_key_help.open_cavity_inlet_size_strategy: Select hybrid_boundary_extension, boundary_extension, boundary_uniform or staged_explicit. The recommended hybrid uses y1 only across a very short normal strip and then directly inherits the real transfinite inlet edge lengths.
editable_key_help.open_cavity_inlet_extension_power: Controls how progressively Gmsh Extend releases the inlet boundary size toward the cavity-core size. Values below one keep the fine boundary-derived scale longer.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_dist_min_chord: Distance from the inlet where the finest tangential interface scale is held. The robust default is 0 so growth starts immediately instead of creating an unnecessarily thick fine band.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_matching_transition_: With the recommended hybrid, normal distance divided by chord over which a short y1-compatible strip grows to the real inlet tangential spacing. The selected 0.002c value is deliberately local; Extend controls the remaining cavity.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_matching_size_factor: Multiplier applied to measured inlet tangential spacing in the matching bands. A value of 1.0 requests equal tangential and local triangular edge scales before normal growth begins.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_near_transition_chor: Distance where the first cavity stage reaches open_internal_inlet_intermediate_size_chord.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_intermediate_size_ch: Intermediate cavity triangle target between the inlet interface and the coarser cavity core.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_dist_max_chord: Extent of inlet refinement into the cavity before reaching cavity-core size.
editable_key_help.open_internal_inlet_size_chord: Manual inlet triangle size, active when automatic BL-derived interface sizing is disabled.
editable_key_help.open_inlet_refinement_bridge_enabled: Embed a nonphysical line across the inlet to control triangular discretization. It is not a wall, patch or BL curve.
editable_key_help.open_nearfield_refinement_enabled: Enable gradual exterior growth from BL-front-compatible triangles to farfield size.
editable_key_help.open_nearfield_dist_min_chord: Distance over which the finest exterior interface size is retained.
editable_key_help.open_nearfield_intermediate_dist_chord: Distance where exterior cells reach the intermediate target.
editable_key_help.open_nearfield_dist_max_chord: Distance where exterior growth reaches its moderate outer-nearfield size.
editable_key_help.open_nearfield_intermediate_size_chord: Intermediate exterior size preventing sudden BL-front to farfield growth.
editable_key_help.open_nearfield_outer_size_chord: Moderate exterior size before the slow transition to farfield.
editable_key_help.open_farfield_transition_dist_chord: Distance where the final transition reaches open_farfield_size_chord.
editable_key_help.open_transition_sigmoid_enabled: Enable smooth sigmoid interpolation in the staged Gmsh Threshold fields.
editable_key_help.wake_refinement_enabled: Optional downstream wake field. Keep disabled for lightweight debugging unless wake resolution is being assessed.
